name: Association Entity Auto-generate
description: Configure associated entities to be auto-generated when associations are created.
project_description: Submodule of Entity Association. Lets an association type declare, per behavior tag, entities that are automatically created and linked whenever a new association of that type is inserted. Each generation rule stores a target entity type/bundle, a token-based label pattern (resolved against the parent association), a published flag, and whether the auto-created entity's label may later be edited. Configuration is stored as third-party settings on the association_type config entity and edited at /admin/structure/association/manage/{type}/autogen.
